title: API Knowledge Signal
description: A single observed signal about an API or its provider — a number, a category, or a tag — sourced from a third-party index (GitHub, Naftiko Signals, job boards, blogs).

value.description: Signal value; left untyped because signal types vary (boolean, number, string, array).

decay.description: Optional ISO-8601 duration after which this signal should be considered stale (e.g. 'P30D').
